cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Yes, I'll help you move the sofa. I'll take the cushions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. We have to lift together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Absolutely. You lift; I'll say when. Together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need another person underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll book someone on your phone. Then I can give both of you the same countdown.

mechanism: A copies a moving technique without understanding it and agrees to each correction only by assigning the labor to B.
confusable: D191 avoids labor; D23 must explicitly agree then reinterpret the agreement in A's favor.
seedUse: D23-a turns together into supervising and then hiring someone else.
